Check.gaccGb28050_1: Energy must ALWAYS be shown in kJ (kilojoules): not kcal alone.
Check.gaccGb28050_2: Mandatory fields: Energy, Protein, Fat, Carbohydrate, Sodium.
Check.gaccGb28050_3: NRV% (Nutrient Reference Values) must be calculated for each mandatory field.
Check.gaccGb28050_4: Additional fields required when making claims (e.g., fiber, vitamins).
Check.gaccGb28050_5: Format must follow the exact table structure shown in GB 28050 appendix.
Check.gaccGb28050_6: Tolerance ranges apply: ≤120% for energy and nutrients, ≥80% for protein, fiber, vitamins.
Check.gaccGb7718_1: All text must be in Chinese. Foreign language may be supplementary but not primary.
Check.gaccGb7718_2: Font size must be no less than 1.8mm for most mandatory items.
Check.gaccGb7718_3: If product has a claimed character (e.g., 'organic', 'natural'), supporting certification required.
Check.gaccGb7718_4: Products containing GMO ingredients must be labeled as per GMO labeling regulations.
Check.gaccGb7718_6: Trans-fat content must be declared if >0.3g per 100g/100mL.
Check.gaccHorizon_aiLabel_desc: Customs is piloting AI systems for automated label compliance review. May reduce label clearance times but also increase initial rejection rates.
Check.gaccHorizon_carbon_desc: China exploring carbon footprint labeling for imported goods. Initially voluntary for food, but may become expected in premium retail channels.
Check.gaccHorizon_cbec_desc: Expected expansion of the cross-border e-commerce positive list to include more food categories, enabling more products to enter via simplified CBEC channel.
Check.gaccHorizon_gb7718_desc: The long-anticipated revision of GB 7718 (label standard) expected to introduce significant changes to labeling requirements including new allergen declaration format, font size requirements, and digital labeling options.
Check.gaccHorizon_healthFood_desc: NHC/CFDA reviewing the health food registration system. Possible streamlining of the filing vs registration classification for functional foods.
Check.gaccHorizon_traceability_desc: GACC is developing a nationwide traceability system for imported food. May require additional batch documentation and digital tracking.

Check.gaccLabel_allergen_req: Mandatory: milk, eggs, fish, crustacea, peanuts, soybeans, wheat, tree nuts.

Check.gaccLabel_productName_mistake: Fanciful names without descriptive standard name
Check.gaccLabel_productName_req: Accurate reflection of product's true nature. Standardized name per GB if exists.

Check.gaccLabel_qs_req: Not required for imported food. Do NOT print QS/SC logo.
Check.gaccLabel_storage_mistake: Generic 'store in cool dry place' when specific conditions needed

ReportSection.cbec3DocMatching: 3-document matching required for CBEC customs clearance.
ReportSection.chineseRPMandatory: The Chinese RP is mandatory for all imported cosmetics. Key responsibilities:
ReportSection.compAllergensChina: 8 mandatory: milk, eggs, fish, crustacea, peanuts, soy, wheat, tree nuts
ReportSection.compAllergensEU: 14 regulated allergens including celery, mustard, lupin, molluscs, sulfites
ReportSection.compAllergensUS: Major 9: milk, eggs, fish, crustacea, peanuts, soy, wheat, tree nuts, sesame
ReportSection.compCountryOfOriginChina: Clearly marked; must not be vague
ReportSection.compCountryOfOriginEU: Required when origin differs from processing
ReportSection.compDateMarkingChina: DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY/MM/DD format; best before + date of manufacture
ReportSection.compDateMarkingEU: Best before (or use by for perishable); DD/MM/YYYY format
ReportSection.compDateMarkingUS: Best if used by; MM/DD/YYYY format typically accepted
ReportSection.compIngredientsChina: Descending order; additives with GB 2760 codes only
ReportSection.compIngredientsEU: Descending order; allergens emphasized; QUID for characterizing ingredients
ReportSection.compIngredientsUS: Descending order; standardized ingredients exempt; allergens in plain language
ReportSection.compLanguageChina: Chinese ONLY mandatory; foreign text supplementary
ReportSection.compLanguageEU: Official EU language(s) of member state where sold
ReportSection.compManufacturerEU: Producer or packer name and address; importer within EU
ReportSection.compManufacturerUS: Manufacturer, packer, or distributor name and address
ReportSection.compNetContentChina: Metric units (g/mL); draining weight for solids in liquid
ReportSection.compNetContentEU: Metric units; drained weight for solid foods in liquid medium
ReportSection.compNetContentUS: Metric + US customary; net weight for solids, net volume for liquids
ReportSection.compNutritionChina: Energy (kJ mandatory!), protein, fat, carbs, sodium + NRV%
ReportSection.compNutritionEU: Energy (kJ+kcal), fat, saturates, carbs, sugars, protein, salt + GDA%
ReportSection.compNutritionUS: Calories, fat, sodium, carbs, protein + %DV; kJ optional
ReportSection.compProductNameChina: Standardized name required; fanciful names must include true nature
ReportSection.compProductNameEU: Legal name + common name; fanciful allowed with clear description
ReportSection.compProductNameUS: Statement of identity; fanciful names must be accompanied by common name
ReportSection.compStorageEU: Storage conditions or temperature needed for perishables
ReportSection.compStorageUS: Required for perishable foods or if shelf life depends on storage
ReportSection.compareChinaVsEuVsUs: China vs EU vs US Label Requirements
ReportSection.compareExportNote: Exporters must meet China requirements regardless of EU/US compliance.
ReportSection.customsClearanceAction: Duties paid. Customs release. Goods delivered to warehouse.
ReportSection.customsLabTestingAction: Samples sent to CNAS lab. Results in 2-5 weeks.
ReportSection.customsPortArrivalAction: CIQ inspects documentation, verifies labels, takes random samples.
ReportSection.customsPreArrivalAction: Submit advance manifest 24h before arrival. Ensure all documents match the cargo.
ReportSection.customsTimelineNote: * Timelines vary by port. Shanghai/Ningbo are fastest (2-5 days). Inland ports may take 1-2 weeks.
ReportSection.emergencyScenario1Cause: Label non-compliance, missing document, or random sampling failure
ReportSection.emergencyScenario1Response: Engage customs broker → Identify issue → Submit corrections → Re-inspection
ReportSection.emergencyScenario2Cause: Incomplete documentation, misclassified product, or testing failure
ReportSection.emergencyScenario2Response: Review rejection reason → Address deficiencies → Re-submit with supplementary materials
ReportSection.emergencyScenario3Cause: Missing Chinese label elements or incorrect format
ReportSection.emergencyScenario3Response: Stop shipment → Re-label at bonded warehouse → Submit corrected labels for approval
ReportSection.gb28050EnergyKJ: Energy must ALWAYS be shown in kJ (kilojoules): not kcal alone.
ReportSection.gb28050Mandatory: Mandatory fields: Energy, Protein, Fat, Carbohydrate, Sodium.
ReportSection.gb28050NRV: NRV% must be calculated for each mandatory field.
ReportSection.gb7718AllChinese: All text must be in Chinese. Foreign language may be supplementary but not primary.
ReportSection.gb7718FontSize: Font size must be no less than 1.8mm for most mandatory items.
ReportSection.gb7718GMO: Products containing GMO ingredients must be labeled as per GMO labeling regulations.
ReportSection.gb7718TransFat: Trans-fat content must be declared if >0.3g per 100g/100mL.
ReportSection.ipCustomsRecordalDesc: Register with Customs for border enforcement against counterfeits.
ReportSection.ipFirstToFileDesc: China awards trademark rights to first filer. File before market entry.
ReportSection.ipMonitorEnforceDesc: Set up watch service. Oppose conflicting marks within 3 months.
ReportSection.labelCheckOffItems: Check off each item as completed. This checklist can be printed and shared with your team.
ReportSection.previewBannerDesc: This is a preview with sample data to demonstrate the report layout.
ReportSection.squattingCaseDesc: A French wine brand spent 3 years and over $50,000 in legal fees to recover its trademark from a local agent who had registered it in China first. The brand was locked out of the Chinese market during the dispute. Moral: register before you launch.
ReportSection.tooltipAnimalTestingExemption: General cosmetics may qualify for animal testing exemption when equipped with EU/US GMP certification and sufficient safety data.
ReportSection.tooltipAssessmentResult: Comprehensively assesses your product's risk level and feasibility for compliance with China import regulations.
ReportSection.tooltipCccProductCatalog: The CCC catalog covers 17 major product categories. Products not in the catalog may still need SRRC (wireless) or NMPA (medical) certification.
ReportSection.tooltipCompetitiveBenchmark: Understand the competitive landscape of similar products in the Chinese market to help you develop market entry strategies.
ReportSection.tooltipImplementationRoadmap: A phased roadmap showing the complete process and timeline from assessment to ongoing compliance.
ReportSection.tooltipMandatoryLabelElements: GB 7718 requires 12 mandatory label elements on imported prepackaged foods. Missing any element may result in customs detention.
ReportSection.tooltipNiceClassification: China uses the 11th edition of the Nice Classification. Choosing the correct goods/services class is core to trademark registration.
ReportSection.tooltipNmpaFilingType: General cosmetics follow notification filing (2-4 months), special cosmetics (sunscreen/whitening) require full registration (6-12 months).
ReportSection.tooltipPlatformComparison: Tmall Global has the largest traffic, JD Worldwide suits electronics/health products, Douyin live-streaming is growing fastest.
ReportSection.tooltipProductClassification: HS codes determine tariff rates and regulatory conditions. Misclassification can lead to overpayment or cargo seizure.
ReportSection.tooltipTariffTaxAnalysis: Total duties = import tariff + VAT + consumption tax. FTA member countries enjoy preferential rates.
ReportSection.cccTestingStandardsDesc: Each product category requires specific GB standards for CCC testing.
ReportSection.niceClassesDesc: Recommended Nice classes by product category:
ReportSection.ipLegalFrameworkTitle: China IP Legal Framework & Enforcement Options
